en: The postcard features a sepia-toned historical photograph of a grand European city square with ornate buildings, a formal park with benches, and a prominent fountain or statue at the center. The reverse side shows decorative borders, Swedish language text, a green stamp reading 'SVERIGE', and handwritten addresses. There are also postal stamps indicating Stockholm and Sundsvall, dated 1903.
